title: [GMCP 203.027.02] Production path: Enterprise and machine-to-machine authorization extensions
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-027-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: GMCP implements and tests official enterprise-managed authorization and OAuth client-credentials extension profiles without conflating user and workload identity. Policy chooses flows explicitly, administrators can constrain issuers and clients, managed settings are tamper-evident, credentials are audience-bound and rotated, and unsupported or draft profiles are labeled and safely declined. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
